name: browser-use
headline: Persona-based MCP server groupings
short_description: A curated collection of persona-based mcp server and tool groupings. Operations teams can quickly deploy tailored AI toolkits for specific roles, improving efficiency and reducing setup time. Connects to Claude agents and other MCP-compatible tools.
author: toolprint

sections.overview:
Awesome MCP Personas is a directory of pre-built, role-specific MCP server configurations that eliminate manual setup overhead. Instead of researching and configuring individual servers, users copy a single persona file to instantly gain 5-15 validated, compatible MCP servers tailored to their role. The collection includes 16 personas covering software engineering, DevOps, database administration, and other specializations. Each persona groups servers from established registries that have been tested for compatibility, removing configuration friction and reducing deployment time from hours to seconds. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Continue, and other MCP-compatible applications.
Python backend engineers deploying filesystem, git, code-checker, and testing servers at once
AWS cloud engineers setting up integrated CloudFormation, EKS, Docker, and database toolkits
Database administrators provisioning Postgres, monitoring, and charting servers together
Operations teams deploying role-specific toolkits across multiple team members
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/toolprint/awesome-mcp-personas`
sections.usage:
```
Create an Awesome MCP Persona for a [ROLE] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Include [NUMBER] MCP servers and [NUMBER] tools. Prioritize [TOOL TYPE] and [TOOL TYPE] for this role. Ensure compatibility with Claude agents and other MCP-compatible tools.
```
Copy

```
# Awesome MCP Persona: Marketing Manager
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
